name: component_comparison_v1
status: FROZEN 2026-10-09 after red-team (DO-NOT-FREEZE as written; F1-F10 applied: F1-F3 in code with failing-first tests, the rest here); changes need a new version
question: does bounded localisation prevent the s_bend jump failures, and does independent final-goal verification reject chain-end declarations that are not at the requested goal without losing correct stops?

checkpoint.name: ft-seed0
checkpoint.reason: held fixed across variants; the stronger checkpoint on the previous comparison

true_chain.tests: route following and correct stopping; consistent-chain look-alikes (the two point-symmetric s_bend bends; mid-route views) occur naturally

truncated_chain.tests: same-scene mismatch: chain ends 0.75-0.96 m short of the requested goal; a chain-only arrival rule declares arrival at the wrong place; verification should withhold it and steer to the requested goal

wrong_chain_swap.tests: gross cross-scene mismatch (junction_0 chain in the s_bend scene), one route

episodes: 4 variants x (4 + 4 + 1 + 2) = 44 attempts; failed or refused attempts are counted in denominators and archived

runtime.controller: reference PD dt 0.5 s + 120 Hz yaw PI (qualification articulated-control-20261009-10)
runtime.enforced_by: collect_option1.py refuses any --variant run whose radius, close threshold, max_v, decision rate, budget, checkpoint, goal root, qualification, yaw feedback, condition root or chain.json hash differ

calibration.lost_data: only arrival-tm-ft-seed0-20261009-02 (163 correctly localised decisions; the 95th percentile rests on about 8 tail points)
calibration.in_sample_caveat: calibration uses the same development routes, goals and chains as the evaluation (different episodes); thresholds are development-calibrated, not validated out of sample
calibration.lost_rule: enter 6.752 (95th pct of on-route window minimum), exit 2.215 (median), patience 3
calibration.verify_rule: learned threshold 7.745: false accept 1.9% pooled over far frames; by band 0.75-1.0 m 4.4% (113 frames), 1.0-1.5 m 2.2%, >1.5 m 0%; true accept 0.40 per frame
calibration.pixel_control: NCC 0.893: band 0.75-1.0 m false accept 9.7%; true accept 0.24; offline only, never controls the robot

lost_and_pause_accounting: lost decisions and verification-pending decisions count against the same 600-frame budget; neither can produce a stop; an episode ending lost or pending is a timeout

measures.outcomes: configs/eval/arrival_measures_v1.json over all attempted episodes; navigation success is labelled goal-region visit (no goal-blind row; pending steering can pass through the region)
measures.localisation_primary: decisions whose current or followed node is more than one node from the pose-true nearest node (evaluation only), plus route departure
measures.localisation_secondary: jump count (lower for B partly by construction)
measures.verification: delay in decisions and seconds from the first chain-goal decision to the stop, for C and D only (A and B: NOT_APPLICABLE); pending decisions; lost decisions

reporting: development evidence; counts per variant x condition with route denominators; paired per-route tables; no significance claims
known_limitations: one checkpoint, four routes, two scenes, one seed
small-command tracking limitation of the yaw loop applies to all variants
calibration and evaluation share routes and scenes (development only); held-out sealed

repeats.reason: only s_bend exercises bend aliasing; repeats also measure run-to-run determinism, which is reported

run_order: for each variant in A, B, C, D: true_chain (4 routes), truncated_chain (4), wrong_chain_swap (1), true_chain repeat (2 s_bend); one Isaac process per collection; source pinned by commit

answer_rules.B_prevents_jumps: answered by mechanism trace: aliased proposals withheld vs followed; if A does not show bend aliasing on an s_bend attempt, that comparison is NOT TESTED, never 'no effect'
answer_rules.C_rejects_wrong_arrival: truncated and swap conditions: chain-end declarations away from the requested goal under A vs under C; plus correct stops lost on the true chain
answer_rules.no_claims: four routes, one checkpoint, one seed: descriptive development evidence only

pre_registered_failure_modes: C/D pending can oscillate when the chain argmin falls back from the goal node (verified_count resets); oscillations are logged via pending decisions and reported
D truncated: steering past the chain end may trigger lost, which clears reached_goal and drags the robot back toward chain nodes
lost episodes are expected to time out rather than recover (lost_exit 2.215 with global-argmin following)
whether a requested goal 0.75-0.96 m away is within the checkpoint's usable goal range is UNKNOWN
scope_limits: yaw-loop small-command tracking limitation applies to all variants
